newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia confectioner to issue Eurobond, shares.
newsitem.headline: Russia confectioner to issue Eurobond, shares.

text.p: Russia's biggest confectioner Red October plans to issue a Eurobond and preferred shares this year, the company's financial advisor ZAO K.O. Finansy said on Wednesday.
K.O.Finansy appointed Brunswick to lead manage the share issue and CS First Boston to lead manage the Eurobond issue, it said in a statement.

AOOT Moskovskaya Konditerskaya Fabrika Krasny Oktyabr (Red October) will issue about 1.5 million shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles to be placed privately, Brunswick corporate finance director Mikhail Brainis told Reuters.
The exact date for the issue will be set at Red October's shareholders' meeting on April 12, the statement said.
No details were available about the Eurobond issue.

Funds raised from the issues will be used to increase production by 30 to 50 percent, to carry out equipment modernisation, to build a new factory in the Moscow region town of Kolomna and set up a network of shops in Moscow.
The projects are to be completed in 1997-1998, the statement said.
Red October was last traded on the Russian Trading System on February 26 at $24.50.
